Every <@ba.vup>{interval}</> seconds, the lightning ball deals <@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</> ATK as Arts damage to all nearby enemies and has <@ba.vup>{prob:0%}</> chance to <$ba.sluggish>Slow</> them for <@ba.vup>{sluggish}</> seconds
<@ba.rem>Can hold {ct} charges</>

char_158_milu.reason: S2 native TileRangedAttack waits for attack event and uses Skill animation, but original default Front Skill has no event of any kind and original Back has no Skill clip. Native animation/ability release dispatch is unrecovered; no guessed release delay or partial full kit is enabled.

char_4006_melnte.reason: S2 projectile preserves native min/max blackboard keys and exact scaleCurve, but no executable source binds its normalized argument to elapsed travel, distance, source position or endpoint. Inventing a distance interpolation would alter damage materially; this complete kit is deferred.

interpretations: Toddifons, Lunacub and Greyy the Lightningbearer implement both selected skills with promotion/potential talent values. Firewatch and Melanite original full kits remain documented but explicitly unsupported pending the listed native dispatch/curve bindings. Optional modules are not applied.

Toddifons native postFilter27 maps to heaviest enemy priority per the pinned Global description; S1 secondaryFilter2/tag sarkaz sorts that race before weight. Original enemy tags from the pinned database identify Sarkaz. Ties retain the shared distance/spawn/taunt rules; exact native selector execution is not recovered. The S1 mark is a snapshot choice and retains taunt addition and final DEF scaler for its full skill duration even when target moves outside range.

Toddifons S2 uses native BASE_ATTACK_TIME formulaItem1 percentage, 10 release-event ammunition and manual discard. Each Skill_2_Loop event invokes separate RangedAttack and SplashAttack. The original direct projectile delayToStart .22 precedes the direct hit; splash has the same .22 startup plus selected splash_projectile_delay_time and original radius1.2. The delayed splash follows current target position and cancels if its original target dies/disappears per original stopIfTargetDead/Disappeared1. Native checkReached/delay/start ordering is unrecovered, so this .22+selected-delay composition is recorded explicitly. Last ammunition retains cast lock through the original clip; launched effects persist independently of source retreat but maintain original target lifetime checks.

Lunacub talent is a native first-wait .1s periodic CheckContainsBuff switch. While neither skill is active it owns camouflage; while active it removes only that camouflage and applies BASE_ATTACK_TIME MULTIPLIER from selected promotion (-.15 at E2). The periodic state swap resumes after the skill, rather than creating a permanent interval reduction. S2 uses start_cam_duration and kill-triggered cam_duration; EXTEND is mapped to remaining-time max(duration), matching shared extension behavior, never addition of successive durations. Kill camouflage is nonderived and may persist after S2 ends as native finishDerivedBuffIfParentFinish false.

Greyy normal projectile flies at10 to its target position and produces ground-only radius.9 physical impacts on arrival and .15s later, second damage using attack@append_atk_scale .5. Two source collider handlers select their victims independently. Native reached/stop/canHitSameTargetMultipleTimes orchestration is interpreted as the two trait waves; no optional third module wave is applied. Slow Dice occurs before each damage instance, including dodges, per active buff ON_BUFF_START.

Greyy S2 is a charged manual cast requiring a ground target and taking the original Skill OnAttack .8s release plus full1.267s cast lock. It launches at8, samples the moving projectile circle radius1 at release and every selected1.5s, then remains at its reached position for selected projectile_delay_time. Original waitFirstPeriod0 and onlyCheckHitWhenReachTarget0 support pulses during flight; native poll/start/expire ordering remains unrecovered. The adapter uses current source ATK for damage, and each pulse uses selected skill .4 probability and sluggish duration rather than normal-talent values. Persisted projectile lifetime is independent of owner retreat; each cast owns its own pulse timer.

Normal attack releases use original facing OnAttack and native animation scaling caps: Toddifons/Lunacub/Greyy cap1. Toddifons and Lunacub exact begin/end clips are shown with mode locks. Original native FSM start/finish ordering, Unity particles/sounds, three-dimensional mount points and recorded-client frame parity are not validated.
